# Karasov Systems

> Vitalii Karasov builds private AI operations systems for design-build,
> remodeling and specialty contractor companies. Independent engineer,
> not an agency.

## What he builds
- Lead response and follow-up automation
- Estimate and proposal pipelines
- Field reporting from voice and photo input
- Project knowledge retrieval over company documents
- Multi-agent systems with traceable, auditable output

## Stack
Claude API, n8n, Python, FastAPI, Supabase pgvector, Next.js, LangGraph, MCP
